facts.fact: The OTR launched the e-TPU platform on 17 September 2026 for online declaration and assessment of the Taxe Professionnelle Unique by micro and small enterprises, per Togo-Presse.

The OTR's e-TPU platform, launched 17 September 2026, lets taxpayers pay the Taxe Professionnelle Unique online from a phone, tablet or computer, per the OTR commissioner general quoted by Togo-Presse.
